Theorem
[Uniqueness of weak solution] ↗ def:weak-solution-hyperbolic-bvp 1. ch7:7.2-thm-4\group Hyperbolic PDE

A weak solution of (1) is unique.

Proof

\sketch For the difference $u$, use the backward primitive $v(t)=\int _t^s u(\tau )\, d\tau $ as a time-dependent test function. Integration in time produces an energy identity at $s$; ellipticity and Gronwall imply $u=0$.

□
